evaluation_design: Keep held-out trigger and code fixtures. Compare skill versus baseline/previous version. Repeat representative cases; record host, backend, model, provider, effort, versions, and environment.

comparison_protocol.repetition: each fixture runs N times per backend per invocation; entries merge into <state>/route-evidence.json across invocations
comparison_protocol.measured_threshold: a route key counts as measured at runs >= 2; fewer runs stay anecdotal and do not shift route scoring
dimensions: success (typed turn outcome plus fixture check, never exit code alone)
precision and recall against seeded findings
scope compliance (changes outside the fixture's allowed files fail the run)

usage_record.unknown: a field the provider did not report is null, never zero or estimated
